get.summary: A job's survey hierarchy (M5a): every Building on the project with its Elevations nested underneath, flat and unpaginated. Neither model carries a price field, so the full tree (address/footprint/geometry/bearing/facing/map pin + the sqft/count/status roll-up) is price-blind with no projection needed. `updatedAfter` is a delta-sync watermark applied at the building level — a tree is included when the building itself OR any of its elevations changed since the watermark; a matched building always returns ALL its elevations, not just the changed ones.

post.summary: Open a work-log session for the caller's own Technician row (M3 B1/B2). `technicianId` is FORCED from the session — never accepted in the body (strict shape, unknown fields 400). `clientUuid` is the app's idempotency key: a retried check-in with an already-seen clientUuid returns the EXISTING row unchanged.

clientUuid.description: Client-minted idempotency key. Unique per business; a retry with the same value never duplicates.

post.summary: Close the caller's own CHECKED_IN work-log session, keyed by the work-log's `clientUuid` rather than its server id (M4 A-B2) — offline, a check-in has no server id yet to reference. A log resolved for another technician 403s; an unknown clientUuid 404s. Idempotent: replaying on an already-CHECKED_OUT log returns that SAME row — 200, never 404/409.

post.summary: Upload a photo for a pane or project (M4b, device session only, append-only — no update/delete/list on this route). entityType is the narrow device contract: 'surface' | 'job' (not the office-side six-holder set). When entityType is 'surface', the stored URL is also appended to that pane's Surface.photoUrls (the denormalized array the web pane editor shows/edits). A cross-tenant or unknown entityId 404s, same as any other tenant-scoped miss.

entityId.description: The pane id (surface) or project id (job) this photo belongs to.

post.summary: A technician adds a face the estimator missed while on-site (M5a). The path id is the Building; body fields mirror createElevationInputSchema minus buildingId (forced from the path) and fieldAdded (always true — this route IS the field-add path). clientUuid is REQUIRED (unlike the office-side schema, where it's optional) — the app's offline idempotency key: a retried add with an already-seen clientUuid returns the EXISTING row unchanged (200), a fresh add answers 201. elevationNumber is auto-assigned server-side (max within the building + 1).

clientUuid.description: Client-minted idempotency key. Unique per business; a retry with the same value never duplicates.

post.summary: Place an already-synced pane onto a building/elevation face (M5a): a technician syncs panes via jobs/{id}/surfaces, then groups one onto the face they are standing at. The path id is the Surface; body fields mirror assignSurfaceInputSchema minus surfaceId (forced from the path). No clientUuid — assigning is naturally idempotent, a replay just re-runs the same update.

schema.description: At least one of buildingId or elevationId must be provided.
